description: Call this when the user asks about the market's hidden liquidity state, PsiCharge, or whether parked money is deploying or stress is unwinding. Returns the current Psi score (0-100), state (superposition = charge building, collapse = low-stress discharge, purge = high-stress discharge and historically the most consistent risk-off state, ground = ordinary), stress locality, recent alarms and the year-split measured scorecard. Inputs are proprietary; outcomes are always published. Not a trade signal, not a crash predictor.
name: get_psi_charge
title: PsiCharge liquidity state (proprietary model, outcomes published)
